component.name: Dackel Launcher
component.summary: Launch Windows games with Proton, with gamepad support

description.p: A game library for Linux and the Steam Deck. It lists the game folders in your libraries, extracts zip downloads, and starts each game through umu and Proton.
Everything works with a gamepad, a mouse or a keyboard. Each game keeps its own settings, Wine prefix and Proton version, and shows its store information for DLsite games.
